meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa - International Company (IC) regime under the International Companies Act 1987, administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law and Samoan statutory law, with customary law recognised only for land and certain personal matters; corporate and trust statutes are modelled on Commonwealth company law principles
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa-New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (signed 31 July 2020, Samoa's first comprehensive DTA)
Samoa-United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement (signed 19 June 2009, effective 2010)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus), in force 13 December 2020
Samoa-China economic and technical cooperation framework agreements supporting bilateral investment facilitation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended by the Money Laundering Prevention Amendment Act 2018, together with the Money Laundering Prevention Regulations 2009; Financial Intelligence Unit domiciled within the Central Bank of Samoa; International Companies Act 1987, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008 (mandatory appointment of a SIFA-licensed registered agent and maintenance of beneficial ownership records); Financial Institutions Act 2000; Companies Act 2001 for domestic company analog; SIFA licensing directives and FIU guidelines applicable to reporting entities; medical-device assembly is additionally subject to import/health-product licences issued by the Samoa Ministry of Health
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Internal - Beneficial ownership information is collected and maintained by the SIFA-licensed registered agent and is not publicly searchable; it is accessible to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, SIFA, the Ministry for Revenue and foreign competent authorities through mutual legal assistance, but no public UBO register exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised and consular-legalised certificate of good standing or corporate existence of any corporate shareholder above the 25% UBO threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate corporate shareholder's home registry and a licensed notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Samoa is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be authenticated by the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade in Apia or through a Samoan diplomatic/consular mission, preceded by notarial certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of passport, proof of residential address, birth certificate and police/character record for every natural-person UBO, director and proposed authorised signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent government authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade or the nearest Samoan consular post; notarially certified copies must be presented to the Samoan registered agent in addition to originals for verification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the applicant entity and professional reference letter from the introducing counsel, covering source of funds and source of wealth of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution regulated in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction, and the introducing law firm or licensed corporate services provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization where the document originates outside Samoa; a risk-based institutional certified copy may be accepted by the Samoan registered agent under its AML/CFT CDD policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended): all directors, shareholders, UBOs and signatories must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the Samoa FIU domestic list, and adverse-media and PEP databases; foreign and domestic PEP status requires senior-management approval and enhanced ongoing monitoring; screening results must be documented in the CDD file and refreshed at each transaction event and at least annually

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Company Name Reservation and Registration service; domestic parallel registry: Companies Office of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; all name applications for an International Company must be transmitted through a SIFA-licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be in the Latin alphabet (English or Samoan) and must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.' or an acceptable equivalent; names in Chinese or other non-Latin scripts are accepted only together with a fully matched English/Samoan transliteration and certified translation, and the certificate of incorporation will record the Latin-script transliterated form; the constitutional documents may be executed in Chinese provided a certified English translation is lodged with the registered agent, with the English text prevailing for legal interpretation
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa, Government, Ministry, or any word implying patronage or official connection with the Government of Samoa (requires written ministerial consent)
Bank, Banking, Building Society, Credit Union, or any deposit-taking connotation (requires a banking licence and regulator consent)
Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, or words implying insurance business (requires insurance regulatory licence)
Trust, Trustee, or words implying fiduciary or trust administration (requires a trust licence or trustee consent)
Fund, Mutual Fund, or collective investment scheme terms (requires fund licence approval)
Chamber of Commerce, University, College, Institute, or professional designation terms (subject to qualifying consents from the relevant body)
Medical, Drug, Pharmacy, Laboratory, Clinic, Health, or related tokens for an ISIC 3250 medical-device scope (prior approval from the Samoa Ministry of Health is required before name clearance)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent must file a written reconsideration application with SIFA within 14 days of the rejection notice, demonstrating a visually and phonetically distinctive element, attaching the ministerial consent certificate where a restricted token is intended, or providing a corrected transliteration; SIFA must decide within 7 business days; if the refusal is upheld, the applicant may apply for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the refusal, and in parallel a fresh name application with a new distinctive name may be filed immediately at the standard SIFA search fee

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or remote-only address is not permissible as the statutory registered office of a Samoa International Company; the International Companies Act 1987, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008, requires a physical registered office in Samoa maintained by a SIFA-licensed registered agent, where statutory records, the member register, charges register and beneficial ownership records are kept; virtual office services are acceptable only for the operational and back-office activities conducted outside Samoa and must not be represented as the registered office
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate, quantified at approximately 15-20% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection during the first year of operation; SIFA and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit conduct risk-based supervisory inspections of licensed registered agents and company premises under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, and the inspection probability increases materially if UBO records, sanction screening outcomes or registered-agent filings show anomalies or late filings

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIFA name search, clearance and reservation of the proposed company name (one name, standard processing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing tariff under the fees regulations made under the International Companies Act 1987

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation and registration fee for a standard authorised share capital structure
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing tariff under the International Companies Act 1987 fees schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment of a SIFA-licensed international company service provider and registered agent - first-year administration, statutory record keeping and regulatory liaison
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent / International Company Service Provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 750-1,200 per annum in Samoa, inclusive of compliance overhead

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provision of the physical registered office address in Samoa (first year, inclusive of mail handling and statutory correspondence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for registered office maintenance in Samoa

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO register setup, statutory record book, register of directors, register of members and register of charges preparation under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate record book production and statutory declaration filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client due diligence onboarding - PEP, UN, OFAC and EU consolidated sanctions screening of all UBOs, directors and proposed signatories, including source-of-funds documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent compliance department as an FIU-designated reporting entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for CDD/KYC file preparation under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarisation and consular legalisation of the UBO identity bundle, corporate good-standing certificates and bank reference letters (where sourced from non-Samoa jurisdictions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade / Samoan consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff plus prevailing notarial fee in the country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency for post-incorporation certificate of good standing and certification of registered charges (for subsequent trade finance and SWIFT LC facilities)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff plus market benchmark for expedited certification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1988 (Samoa), as amended, sections 8, 12, 18 and Schedule 2
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority — Registry of International Companies (SIFA Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company, filed via form IC-1 together with Notice of Registered Office and Company Agents
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorised capital may be stated in the Memorandum. No escrow account or capital deposit is required for non-resident owners.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the initial allotment of 10,000 ordinary shares at USD 1.00 each be and hereby is subscribed by the founding shareholder pursuant to clause 4 of the Memorandum. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office shall be situated at Level 3, SIFA Business Centre, Apia, Samoa, and that the licensed Registered Agent be appointed to maintain the statutory registers. RESOLVED FURTHER that Mr. David Leung be appointed as Director and Ms. Mabel Clarke as Corporate Secretary to hold office until the next annual general meeting. RESOLVED that the officers be and are hereby authorised to execute all incorporation filings, open correspondence with the Registry, and settle all applicable government fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority — Registry of International Companies (online CRC system)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names via the SIFA Registry e-reservation portal; pay the name reservation fee of USD 30; provide shareholder identity details and intended business purpose. Receive approval certificate within one working day.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of beneficial owner bank (optional)
Business plan description on ISIC 3250 scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for resemblance or objectionable character, file an administrative appeal with the Registrar within 10 days; amend the name or request a waiver of similarity where written consent is obtained from the prior registrant.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public licensed in Samoa / Subscriber directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English or bilingual format, incorporating standard SIFA International Company clauses. Execute before a notary and have the instrument witnessed by the appointed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and secretary
Certificate of incorporation application cover sheet
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarisation is queried for missing witness signature, re-execute the document in the physical presence of a notary, paying an additional stamp duty of USD 10 per instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Form IC-1 Submission to SIFA Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum, Articles and form IC-1, together with a certified copy of identification documents of each subscriber and proposed officer. Attach the name reservation certificate and registered agent engagement letter.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies of directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registry issues a query for incomplete beneficial ownership data, submit a supplemental declaration of beneficial owner and pay the query-response fee of USD 50; Registry shall re-commence processing upon cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Incorporation Fee and Stamp Duty
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa Ministry of Revenue — Electronic Payments Window / SIFA Registry Cashier
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the statutory incorporation fee of USD 150 and any stamp duty assessed on the issuance of shares, via SWIFT wire or TT to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue account, and upload the payment voucher as part of the closure of the IC-1 file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If duplicate payment is detected, an automatic refund is issued within 15 working days; if payment window rejects the transaction, re-run through an approved commercial bank remitter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation in the name of the International Company, together with the registered office record identifying the SIFA-licensed agent, and the company enters the public register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error in the company name, file a rectification request with the Registrar supported by the Memorandum; correction is completed within 2 working days at no additional fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Ministry of Health — Therapeutic Products Management Unit (TPMU)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturing Facility Licence (MDMFL) for Class IIb Electronic Patient Monitoring Equipment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Samoa Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Planning and Urban Management Agency
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Preliminary EIA (Category B) — low-moderate risk requiring an Environmental Compliance Certificate prior to equipment installation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater pH 6.0–8.5, BOD5 not exceeding 20 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L; VOC emissions limited to 50 mg/m3 for solder/cleaning operations; hazardous waste to be stored in sealed drums and collected by an MNRE-approved waste carrier within 90 days; noise limit of 65 dBA at site boundary during daytime production hours.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) — Fire Safety Certificate for commercial and manufacturing premises; Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure — structural load inspection certification for production floor slab and storage shelving; Samoa Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Division — workplace safety clearance certificate verifying first-aid readiness, eye-wash stations, grounding of ESD workstations, and operator training records before production launches.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue of the Independent State of Samoa, Apia (Samoa Tax Online Services portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Not required for an exempt International Company operating solely offshore; if the IC establishes a Samoa taxable business or voluntarily registers for VAGST, its registered agent must file Form TR-1 with the Ministry of Revenue together with (i) certificate of incorporation; (ii) IC registration certificate under the International Companies Act 1987; (iii) registered agent consent; and (iv) beneficial ownership declaration. A TIN and, where applicable, VAGST number are issued within five working days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Samoa law. The International Company is statutorily exempt from Samoan income, corporate, stamp, capital gains, and withholding taxes. No election to be taxed is permitted; the only route to domestic tax status is discontinuance/continuance as a local company under the Companies Act 2006, which is a corporate status change rather than a tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 100,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (VAGST Act 2008); international companies supplying goods or services wholly outside Samoa are outside the charge to VAGST and are not required to register.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or e-invoicing API mandate exists. Registered persons must issue a VAGST tax invoice showing supplier name and TIN/VAGST number, recipient details, date, description, taxable amount, rate, and tax, and must retain records for at least seven years. PDF/e-invoicing is permitted; there is no digital stamp, SAF-T, or continuous transaction control.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAGST-registered person zero-rates a supply of tangible goods (including electronic patient monitors) where the goods are exported from Samoa by the supplier or on the supplier's instructions, and the goods are removed from Samoa no later than 30 days after the taxable supply. Services directly and exclusively for exporting the goods, and certain offshore services supplied to non-resident recipients, are also zero-rated. Evidence must demonstrate movement of goods out of Samoa and receipt of foreign-currency payment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) evidencing Samoan port/airport departure
Inward Remittance Certificate (or SWIFT MT103/MT700 bank credit evidence)
Manufacturer’s Certificate of Origin for the ECG monitor
VAGST zero-rating substantiation schedule maintained by the exporter
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Samoa Ministry of Revenue may, during audit, recapture VAT previously zero-rated where (i) goods were not physically exported within statutory deadlines, (ii) customs documentation is missing or contradictory, (iii) FX proceeds were not repatriated or credited within 180 days, or (iv) the customer/supply chain was part of a circular or refund fraud. Penalties include the full 15% VAGST clawback, a retrospective shortfall penalty not exceeding 150% of the tax for deliberate or negligent conduct, late payment interest up to 2% per month, and, for fraudulent export documentation, criminal liability under the Tax Administration Act 2015 with fines up to SAT 200,000 and imprisonment up to seven years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), established by the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984; the sole monetary authority and foreign-exchange administrator. Exchange control is administered under the Exchange Control Act 1970, the Exchange Control Regulations 1971, the Exchange Control (Amendment) Act 1994 and the CBS Foreign Exchange Control Policy 2008. The Central Bank licenses commercial banks as authorised dealers and delegates routine current-account approvals to them; capital-account transactions above delegated bank limits require CBS prior consent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa Tala (WST) is a central-bank-managed floating currency operating within a crawling band against a trade-weighted basket dominated by the AUD, NZD and USD. Current-account payments for bona-fide cross-border trade in goods and services are freely convertible upon presentation of standard commercial documentation; no FX auction or allocation rationing applies. Capital-account transactions, including portfolio investment, offshore borrowing and resident-entity direct investment, remain restricted and require CBS approval or reliance on a standing general permission. For the subject WS_IC, a non-resident International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), the statute exempts a non-resident international company from the Exchange Control Act in respect of foreign-currency operations. Consequently, inbound equity capital, trade settlements, dividend and profit remittances, and intercompany treasury movements in USD or EUR may flow freely without CBS approval. Profit-remittance hurdles crystallise only if the IC maintains a WST-denominated account, invoices Samoan-domiciled customers, or converts foreign currency into WST for onshore expenditure; such onshore legs require audit evidence, a Samoa Ministry of Revenue tax clearance where applicable, and the CBS-prescribed exchange-control permission application.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For Samoan-resident exporters the Exchange Control Regulations 1971, as read with CBS General Permission instruments, impose a mandatory repatriation and surrender structure: export proceeds must be received within 180 days from the date of shipment, must be denominated in an approved foreign currency, and, once received, must be offered for conversion to WST through an authorised dealer within 30 days of receipt; the statutory conversion ratio is 100% unless the CBS grants a foreign-currency-account retention permit or an export-incentive exemption for defined trade contracts. The WS_IC International Company is treated as non-resident for exchange-control purposes, and the physical goods flow for the ECG patient-monitor value chain (third-country component supply, sub-assembly and final calibration, followed by export to regional distributors) does not enter or leave Samoan customs territory. The effective surrender obligation is therefore 0%, and 100% of USD-denominated export proceeds may be retained in the offshore operational account. This status must be reconfirmed annually through the registered agent's non-resident declaration and, where requested by the receiving bank, a CBS advance ruling letter.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) Limited, Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Multi-currency Operational Account (USD, EUR, WST)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: ANZ Bank (Samoa) Limited, Beach Road, Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Documentary Credit / Commercial LC Issuing Facility

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Registration Fee and Registered Agent Continuation (International Companies Act 1987, as amended; International Companies (Fees) Regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa — submitted through the licensed Samoa registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually on the exact anniversary of incorporation; if the anniversary falls on a weekend or Samoa public holiday, payment is due on the next business day in Apia
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid fees attract a late-payment penalty and may be recovered as a civil debt; continued non-payment after the statutory notice period (generally six months) permits administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company, with reinstatement available only by court order on payment of all arrears, penalties and restoration fees.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No Samoa statutory audit threshold applies to an International Company; audit is not triggered by asset, revenue or shareholding thresholds. An independent audit becomes necessary only if the board or shareholders so resolve, a Samoa court orders it, or a financing counterparty or lending bank requires audited IFRS financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies Act 1987 records obligation: accounting records must sufficiently explain transactions, assets, liabilities and financial position. Any externally issued financial statements should be prepared in accordance with IFRS; no local tax-basis statements are required because the International Company is tax-exempt in Samoa.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent conducts an annual UBO refresh before paying the government fee: it reconciles the share register, transfer instruments, shareholder consents and current control percentages; any share transfer during the year is entered in the Register of Members with transfer details and the UBO schedule is updated. The agent retains a signed annual UBO confirmation for production to the Registrar or Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit on request; no public UBO filing is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500–6,000 per engagement (only if counterparty-required or voluntarily engaged; not a statutory cost)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% for resident domestic companies per the Income Tax Act 2006; 0% effective rate for an International Company ('IC') under the statutory exemption in Section 7 of the International Companies Act 1987, as amended.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full and permanent income tax exemption for an IC: no corporate income tax, no deemed-profit tax, no capital gains tax, no stamp duty, and no dividend, interest or royalty withholding tax on offshore-sourced business income of an IC. Offshore business income of the IC is tax-exempt for the entire existence of the company; the IC is outside the domestic income tax net and is not required to file income tax returns.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return Form for International Companies (Section 37, International Companies Act 1987, as amended), electronically lodged through the Samoa International Companies Online Registry portal operated by the Office of the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government licence fee is payable on the same anniversary date (fee schedule based on authorised share capital).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name of the International Company as appearing in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact statutory name; a foreign trade name may be added for non-resident clients; a Samoan name is not required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company number allocated by the Registrar (C-number).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the MCIL registration number exactly; this reconciles the annual fee ledger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address maintained in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the physical address of the Samoan registered agent; a PO Box is insufficient for compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, licence number and address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoan-licensed registered agent is mandatory; foreign corporate service providers cannot act as agent for a Samoan IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors: full names, nationalities, residential addresses and dates of appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; attach passport copies and current address proof; disclose all directors including alternates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders: full names, addresses, shareholding classes and number of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee shareholders are permitted, but the beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance, including the solvency statement, signed by all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may sign remotely; the Samoan registered agent countersigns and keeps the beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government licence fee remittance schedule with payment confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payable in WST by wire; retain the portal receipt as proof of timely compliance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement penalty of WST 100 per month or part of a month; default beyond three months exposes the IC to involuntary striking-off by the Registrar; restoration costs of WST 500 plus all arrears apply after deregistration; directors are jointly and severally liable for unpaid annual fees under Section 110A of the Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Domestic companies: final non-resident withholding tax of 10% on dividends under the Income Tax Act 2006. International Companies: 0% — dividend distributions by an exempt IC are free of all Samoan withholding tax and income tax by operation of Section 7 of the International Companies Act 1987.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where a treaty applies (Samoa's DTA network: New Zealand, Australia, Norway), the non-resident beneficial owner submits to the Ministry for Revenue a treaty relief application form, a certified Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its residence authority, a beneficial ownership certificate and supporting financial records; the Ministry issues a Notice of Reduced Withholding and the payer applies the reduced treaty rate, or refunds excess withholding within 12 months. A Samoan IC, being tax-exempt, neither suffers Samoan WHT on its outbound dividends nor requires a treaty claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 15%; treaty-reduced rates of 5% under the Samoa-New Zealand and Samoa-Australia conventions for equipment and software royalties. Interest: statutory 15%; treaty-reduced to 5-10% depending on the beneficiary. Outbound royalties and interest paid by an IC are subject to 0% Samoan WHT and 0% Samoan tax; no thin-capitalisation restriction applies to exempt ICs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 2,000,000 (circa USD 745,000) in aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File preparation for domestic resident companies; a Master File is required where group turnover exceeds WST 40,000,000. An exempt Samoan IC does not file TP documentation domestically, but must keep transfer-pricing records in Samoa evidencing arm's-length pricing of its patient-monitoring assembly and calibration services in case a foreign parent CFC or transfer-pricing audit re-characterises the IC's profits.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Rules, an IC must demonstrate that core income-generating activities (for this scope: contract manufacturing, calibration and quality control of multi-parameter bedside telemetry monitors) are undertaken in Samoa, or in a jurisdiction imposing equivalent substance requirements, with adequate physical premises, employees and annual expenditure in Samoa. Non-compliance attracts a penalty of up to WST 10,000 per violation, exchange-of-information disclosures to foreign tax authorities and cancellation of the IC's tax-exemption status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Misuse of Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the exempt Samoan IC to conceal taxable ECG monitor manufacturing and distribution revenues that in substance belong to an operating company, or signing declarations falsely characterising the IC's activity while channelling profits without arm's-length compensation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Income Tax Act 2006: recovery of evaded tax plus a civil penalty of up to 200% of the evaded amount plus prescribed interest; wilful evasion is a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to WST 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise false declarations are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of tax underpaid; the Commissioner may issue garnishee orders and travel bans; convicted directors face imprisonment, disqualification from acting as directors and cross-border enforcement flagging.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure letterbox with no office, staff, records or substantive activities in Samoa, no annual return filings, and no demonstrated core income-generating activity while claiming full tax exemption on ECG monitor assembly profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: International Companies Act 1987 and Economic Substance Rules: deregistration and striking-off of the IC, cancellation of the tax-exemption certificate, a monetary penalty of up to WST 50,000 and notification to the OECD Inclusive Framework with a consequent black-listing or downgrade risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be made personally liable for debts incurred while the IC traded without substance; courts can order reimbursement of distributed profits, civil restoration, travel bans and director disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering and Financial Crime
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring Swift_LC and TT_Wire payment rails to disguise tainted funds embedded in patient-monitor hardware sales, or failing to conduct customer due diligence and to report suspicious transactions involving nominee shell counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Samoa AML/CFT Act 2016: money laundering is punishable by a fine of up to WST 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 25 years; failure to report a suspicious transaction attracts a fine of up to WST 500,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent face criminal liability for knowing participation; sanctions include asset confiscation, travel bans, permanent disqualification from acting as a director, imprisonment and INTERPOL red-notice exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and CFC Attribution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intercompany ECG monitor assembly and calibration services to the Samoan IC below the arm's-length margin, or parking profits in the exempt IC without local substance, thereby triggering adjustment and attribution of profits by a parent-country revenue authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Samoa, the exempt IC bears no domestic income tax, but the Registrar may adjust records, deregister the IC and activate exchange-of-information notifications to treaty partners; abroad, the mispriced profit is re-characterised as a dividend subject to foreign dividend withholding or CFC tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false intercompany agreements face personal liability in civil recovery proceedings in the parent jurisdiction as shadow directors; foreign tax authorities may obtain travel bans and personal assessment orders pending final adjustment.
